However, as he aged, he developed numerous issues with his kidneys, teeth, and more. Fast forward to a broken toe, GI infection, and cancer diagnosis and we were looking at significant vet bills. HPaws really stood beside us as we moved thru life with him. They accepted our documentation, quickly processed claims, and made the difference between affordable health care for our boy and a significant financial impact to us. Yes, our premiums went up. But that was understandable, given his situation. Bottom line: We can't say enough good things abt our experience. Insurance thru HPaws was one of the best decisions we made.

title: Appalled at Company's Behavior & Integrity
text:
I've never had too much of a problem with Healthy Paws. I've had 90% coverage and $250 deductible since roughly 2016. 

Today, customer service emailed me stating that my dog's medical records said a different breed than what she was registered with Healthy Paws.

The different breeds in question?
Hound Mix
Mixed Breed

They said if I didn't get my vet to send medical records stating she was a mixed breed, that they'll drop my coverage to 70% , 500$ deductible, and raise my premium up by $169.01. 

My dog is a mixed breed. Hound mix is best guess. I have no idea how they are actually trying to pass this off as a legitimate issue.
